caption: The drawing depicts a farm scene with various sections and buildings. In the upper part, there are three buildings with red roofs and beige walls, one of which has two chimneys with smoke. To the right, there is a structure with an arched red door. A series of black and green trees line the midsection, creating a border between the upper and lower halves. In the lower portion, there are rectangular plots filled with stylized vegetation, including green plants, red and pink flowers, and shrubs. There is a yellow path with a red border leading from the house on the left. The background is a light beige color, and the drawing is bordered by a wavy ribbon pattern with circles, primarily in black and yellow, and a top border featuring a garland motif with red, black, and purple details. The overall color palette consists mainly of beige, greens, reds, blacks, and yellows.
title: Over Mantel Picture
